The '''2002–03 Ekstraklasa''' is the 77th season of the [[List of Polish football champions|Polish Football Championship]] and the 69th season of the [[Ekstraklasa]], [[Polish football league system|the top Polish professional league]] for [[association football]] clubs, since its establishment in [[1927 Ekstraklasa|1927]].

==Overview==
16 teams competed in the 2002-03 season. [[Wisła Kraków]] won the championship.
